object.description: Setup: a build with database schema version 1 installed with 2 saved workouts, including splits. Steps: 1. Install the current build over it without uninstalling. 2. Open History and each workout. 3. Open DatabaseModule.kt and read the migrations registered. Expected: Both workouts are listed with unchanged distance, duration and splits; heart rate values of workouts recorded before heart rate support are empty; the upgrade ran MIGRATION_1_2 and did not fall back to destructive migration. LatLngSerializationTest.path stored before heart rate existed still decodes proves only the route decoding.
